units.function: Maps six UI category toggles to a selected package-file set, distinguishing one-off versus recurring tasks and retaining content-addressed blobs according to attachment and embedded-asset ownership closure.
units.dependencyDirection: UI helper depends on shared portability manifest types and English presentation labels. It derives an export file set client-side from raw paths and manifest ownership metadata, while the server performs the actual export.
units.keyDataModels: ExportCategorySelection, issue path/recurring/attachment projections, embedded asset digest/ownedBy projections and Set<string> selected file paths.
units.lifecycle: Default every category on; classify raw paths; compute task and embedded blob owners; retain a blob when any selected owner qualifies; always retain root/unknown paths; return the checked-file set.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 19/19 tests on 2026-08-19. Coverage is strong for category toggles, recurring task splits, shared attachment blobs, embedded multi-owner blobs, ownerless roots and counts. It does not challenge path normalization, unknown categories/owners, malformed digests, missing references, root metadata leakage, data classification or server/client selection divergence.
units.designRationale: Present understandable category toggles instead of thousands of file checkboxes while preventing obvious orphan attachment blobs.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs purpose- and authority-scoped export planning where the server computes a canonical selected entity/evidence graph and the Web only renders and confirms it.
units.companyOsFit: REIMPLEMENT selection as a server-side typed plan over normalized entity identities, data classifications and responsibility/evidence dependencies. ADAPT the multi-owner blob-closure algorithm and focused test matrix as one projection, then bind the approved plan to the package digest.
units.responsibilityConflict: The six categories omit humans, responsibility contracts, approvals, evidence and data-authority scopes. Root metadata and unknown/ownerless files are always included, so the checked set cannot prove least-privilege export or exact accountable approval scope.
evidence: 916c13501f80c7d1d659b89e4a06dc47366aa80f Replace host-to-host Cloud Sync with full-fidelity company Import/Export (#10507)
securityFindings: All categories default on, and root, unknown and unclassified files are always exported.
Unknown embedded owner strings and ownerless embedded assets fail open to inclusion.
Raw prefix classification occurs without canonical path validation; malformed or future paths can fall into the always-exported null category.
Unreferenced blobs are included whenever attachments remain on, rather than failing closed or requiring explicit purpose.
COMPANY.md, .paperclip.yaml and images remain selected even when every business category is off and may retain references or sensitive metadata.
Client-side selection is not bound to a server revision, authorization decision, reviewed plan digest or emitted package digest.
